name: The Garden of Words
source:
The visual novel Adaptation of the 2013 animation by Makoto Shinkai, The Garden Of Words (Kotonoha no Niwa). The visual novel tells the same story as the movie: 'Is age gap romance really possible?' It puts the question in the minds of the readers, using the scenes and cutscenes and even the soundtrack of the movie. This VN will surely leave an imprint in the minds of the readers.
Is it fate that made a boy, who wants to be a shoemaker and a woman who is skipping work due to unknown reasons meet? How will their story unfold?
translation:
改编自新海诚2013年动画的视觉小说《言叶之庭》。视觉小说讲述了与电影相同的故事：“年龄差距浪漫真的可能吗？”它利用电影的场景、过场动画甚至配乐将这个问题放在读者的脑海中。这个VN一定会在读者的脑海中留下印记。
一个想成为鞋匠的男孩和一个因不明原因旷工的女人相遇是命运吗？他们的故事将如何展开？
